summary.text: Paris Walker-Thomas is an independent write-in candidate for the Illinois State Senate, District 14, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

According to Ballotpedia, she was born in Chicago in 1984, graduated from Central State University with a bachelor's degree in 2006, and has worked as a paralegal, sales marketing manager and internet manager.

paragraphs.text: Paris Walker-Thomas also ran as a Democratic write-in candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 28 in the March 17, 2026 primary, receiving 22 votes against incumbent Robert Rita, who received 10,814.
